Info.Name: Microsoft FrontPage Extensions - Information Disclosure
Info.Description: Frontpage Server Extensions allows remote attackers to determine the name of the anonymous account via an RPC POST request to shtml.dll in the /_vti_bin/ virtual directory.

Info.Name: Jakarta Tomcat 3.1 and 3.0 - Information Disclosure
Info.Description: Jakarta Tomcat 3.1 and 3.0 under Apache contain a vulnerability in the Snoop servlet that reveals sensitive system information when a remote attacker requests a nonexistent URL with a .snp extension, exploit requires remote access.

Info.Name: Cisco IOS HTTP Configuration - Authentication Bypass
Info.Description: HTTP server for Cisco IOS 11.3 to 12.2 allows attackers to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary commands, when local authorization is being used, by specifying a high access level in the URL.
